race.comment: THE MOUNT (3) looked good in a weaker event when racing a fortnight back. He does race his best early in campaigns so look for a similar effort sitting forward in the run. A good surface would be best for him. PONTE ARCOBALENO (2) is another coming through Manangatang form. He was well liked in that race and finds a lovely barrier to sit just in behind them early. Will be attacking the line. BALGOWAN (11) led last week and was only grabbed late. She doesn't have the easiest of draws but has backed up well before. MOOSE JAW (8) is a winner here previously. She has struggled first up before but if the track is soft, that will benefit her. SMASHING RUBY (10) went her best race for some time. She can improve off that.
